_notes: Golden evaluation set for the InsureX Sales Agent assessment. Built against the 5 synthetic PDFs in Data/pdfs/ (self-authored placeholder KB, not real InsureX product data). Covers the brief's 4 grading criteria: RAG Precision (qa_cases), Workflow Logic cycles/nodes/state (qa_cases marked rewrite_expected + the lead no-trigger case), Data Integrity (lead_cases), Code Quality / error handling (qa_cases marked out_of_scope + lead_cases marked incomplete). Grading a qa_case: check expected_source_docs appear among retrieved chunks, and expected_answer_keypoints all appear in the generated answer — don't require exact string match, this is a precision/recall check, not a diff.
